name: Practice manager
summary: Runs the admin side of dental, physio, vet and therapy practices: front-desk and patient flow, appointment books, recalls, rotas and KPIs. No clinical or legal advice.

changelog.note: First release: 29 sources (Jane, Cliniko, Dentally and Open Dental help pages, HIPAA rule text via Cornell LII, GDPR, UK data act, CQC, DSPT, GDC, CMA vets Order, CMS estimates, rest breaks, overtime), four skills (patient flow, appointment book and rota, recalls, KPI pack), five prompts, three workflows, training interview and test briefs, access levels per tool.

Named the UK regulator as the Information Commission, which replaced the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) on 30 Sep 2026 and still uses the ICO name. Cited the regulator's special category data guidance.
